column1: # XML tag samples Usage002_02/03/04: Java class factory recipes / Rust public rule composition.
# Hand oracle from the sample grammars, not from either implementation.
# input escapes: \r \n \t \\; empty first column = empty input.
# Recipe cells: N = success, consumed CP = matched CP = N, parsed source = first N CP;
# 02: no name comparison. paired: Usage002_03 and Usage002_04 (MatchedTokenParser over earlier names).
#   A close tag matches the first earlier tag name in the current parse path that prefixes the input.
#   Rows here never depend on the order of those candidates below the root (see xml-tags-history.tsv).
# scoped: owned capture + capture scope + replay of the innermost open name (not a sample class).

column5: close name is a strict prefix
close name extends the open name
outer name first in history, no prefix clash
history: any earlier open name closes (MatchedTokenParser)
root close tries earlier names in order: a wins the prefix, then > fails, no retry
history: root closed by its child's name
